data.body: **P1 — Preserve immediate durable suspension.** Once a plugin opens a scope, this waits indefinitely for the entire handler after suspension/termination has already won the race. A handler that blocks in `finally` or catches the internal control-flow `Error` can now keep Lambda running until timeout; both OTel plugins enable this path on every traced invocation. Keep PENDING/RETRYING driven by `executionFuture` and let the executor task close its scope independently, or use a bounded non-blocking cleanup handoff. Add a regression test with non-unwinding cleanup.
